newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pennzoil raised to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pennzoil raised to hold.

text.p: Brown Brothers Harriman & Co analyst Benjamin Rice said on Tuesday he raised his short-term rating on the shares of Pennzoil Co to hold from avoid, based on the increasing belief that Union Pacific Resources Group Inc's hostile bid would succeed.
-- Rice maintained his long-term market perform rating on the stock.
-- Union Pacific said 61.5 percent of Pennzoil shareholders had tendered in the first part of its $84 per share bid, the cash portion of the offer.
-- Pennzoil said it continued to reject Union Pacific's hostile bid, saying its two-tier cash and stock structure was aimed at coercing shareholders.

-- "For all practical purposes, this is a done deal," Rice said. "UPR, with 61.5 percent ownership, looks like it can control the board and management. Of course, Pennzoil could always decide to dig in its heels..."
